scope.audience: iPhone players who like calm logic puzzles, plus search engines and AI assistants that summarise the game
scope.primary_goal: Understand what Skepfield is and that it is coming soon to the App Store (unreleased: no store link, badge or price)
excluded: host-root files in repo nguyenvanlamm.github.io (read, not editable)
limitations: Lab evidence only (Playwright + Chrome 154 on one Linux machine and network); no field Core Web Vitals, no analytics, no crawler logs
No screen-reader or real-iPhone test; keyboard order and focus checked in desktop Chrome only
Agent-readiness scan was normalised to the origin https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io and is cited only as corroboration
Inline review path: this run is itself a delegated member of design-optimizer, so no nested reviewer workers were spawned
No repo sync: the checkout is read-only for this run and the manifest records it at origin/main 100ab67 (= live)

evidence.observation: Live index returned 200 at the canonical URL; full content (headings, rules, seasons, privacy block) is present in the initial HTML; meta robots 'index, follow, max-image-preview:large'; canonical matches the URL
evidence.limitations: Saved HTML; no rendering or runtime behaviour

evidence.source: evidence/screenshots/desktop.png (1440 wide full page), mobile.png (390 wide full page), mobile-fold.png (390x844)
evidence.observation: Approved sage/hedgerow/beeswax palette and Alegreya type render as designed; hero shows label, H1, sub-copy, the 'Coming soon to the App Store' pill and four trust chips above the fold at 390x844; the blank band below the footer in desktop.png is the 4200 px capture window exceeding the 3758 px document, not page content
evidence.limitations: Only these viewports; screenshots do not prove semantics

evidence.observation:
Lines 67-69 load Google Fonts (preconnect + css2 stylesheet); line 87 focus style 'outline: 3px solid var(--straw)'; lines 166-169 .calm panel background var(--hedge) with links coloured var(--card); line 211 and 303 '

Coming soon to the App Store

' (not a link or button); line 213 trust chip 'No tracking'; line 288 'Skepfield shows no ads and collects nothing about you'; landmarks header/nav(aria-label)/main/footer, h1 then h2/h3 in order, decorative shapes aria-hidden, both screenshots have descriptive alt
evidence.limitations: Source-only; deployed equality relies on the manifest note (branch = origin/main 100ab67)

evidence.observation: Lines 30-32 load Google Fonts; line 53 'li::marker { color: var(--straw); font-weight: 800; }' styles the numbers of the 'How to play' ordered list (lines 72-77); line 69 asks users to email a personal Gmail address; ContactPage JSON-LD lines 24-29

Lines 68-95 describe only what the game stores and does; there is no section about this website (hosting logs, third-party font requests) or about emails sent to support; lines 30-32 load Google Fonts

evidence.method: Playwright (global install) driving system Chrome 154, 3 pages x 3 viewports (390x844 mobile, 320x640 mobile, 1440x900), PerformanceObserver LCP/CLS, navigation timing, cold context per run
evidence.observation: FCP 0.70-1.62 s and LCP 0.70-1.62 s in 8 of 9 runs; one outlier (privacy, 320) LCP 3.55 s driven by a 3.33 s TTFB; CLS 0-0.026; no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth = clientWidth at 320, 390 and 1440 on all three pages); index 11 requests / 226 KB, support 8 / 121 KB, privacy 7 / 97 KB; no JavaScript
evidence.limitations: Single lab run per cell on one network; not field data; timings vary with network

evidence.observation: Every sampled page requests fonts.googleapis.com (CSS) and fonts.gstatic.com (3-5 woff2 files, about 72-139 KB) on load; all other requests are same-origin
evidence.limitations: What Google does with the request data is not observable from the client

evidence.method: Playwright keyboard Tab x12 at 1440x900, computed outline per focused element
evidence.observation: index tab order: Skepfield home > Rules > Support > privacy policy > Privacy > Support > Contact, then wraps; every link shows a 3px solid rgb(168,114,31) outline; the 'Coming soon to the App Store' pill is never focused (it is static text); support and privacy orders are logical
evidence.limitations: Desktop Chrome only; no screen reader, no iOS VoiceOver

evidence.method: WCAG relative-luminance contrast on CSS tokens; rendered screenshot of the focused link
evidence.observation: Text pairs pass AA (ink on sage 10.84, ink-2 on sage 5.97, beeswax label on hedgerow 4.60, entrance on beeswax 9.08); focus outline straw #A8721F against the hedgerow panel #2F5636 = 2.03:1 (screenshot shows a dim ring around 'privacy policy'); straw list markers on card #FAFBF6 = 3.97:1; soil #5E4A2E on card = 8.09:1, #8A5D17 on card = 5.52:1
evidence.limitations: Token-level calculation; gradients and anti-aliasing not sampled per pixel

evidence.source: shots/index-m320-hero.png, index-m320-rules.png, index-m320-seasons.png, index-m320-end.png, index-768-fold.png, support-m390-full.png, privacy-m390-full.png, *-m320-full.png
evidence.method: Playwright element screenshots (320 CSS px, DPR 2) and google-chrome --headless=new at 768x1024
evidence.observation: At 320 the H1, pill and chips wrap cleanly, rule cards and season lists stack; at 768 the single-column hero keeps the screenshot centred; support and privacy read as one card with the same brand header and footer
evidence.limitations: Landscape, text-spacing overrides and real devices not tested

evidence.observation: 'User-agent: * / Allow: /', 'Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes', comment 'all crawlers welcome, including search and AI bots', and line 20 'Sitemap: https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/skepfield-site/sitemap.xml'
evidence.limitations: Configured policy, not proof that verified crawlers fetch the pages

evidence.observation: Three URLs (home, support.html, privacy.html), each equal to that page's canonical, lastmod 2026-10-28 which matches the live Last-Modified header (Wed, 28 Oct 2026 13:48:30 GMT); 404.html is excluded and carries noindex
evidence.limitations: Structure read by eye, not with a sitemap validator

evidence.source: evidence/site-llms.txt, evidence/llms.txt (host root); live HEAD https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/skepfield-site/llms.txt -> 200 text/plain
evidence.method: orchestrator capture plus one read-only curl
evidence.observation: Project llms.txt has H1, a blockquote summary, fact bullets (rules, controls, bees, Almanac, free vs one-time unlocks, privacy) and a '## Pages' list of the three canonical URLs; every fact matches index/support/privacy copy; host-root llms.txt links to it
evidence.limitations: Provider adoption of llms.txt is not evidenced

evidence.method: JSON parse of each ld+json block and comparison with visible copy
evidence.observation: All three blocks parse; index graph WebSite + VideoGame/MobileApplication with stable @id, iOS/iPhone, Puzzle, isAccessibleForFree true, screenshots, no offers/rating/price (matches the unreleased state); support ContactPage and privacy WebPage (dateModified 2026-10-28 = visible date) point to the same @ids
evidence.limitations: No external rich-result validator run; rich-result eligibility is not expected without offers/ratings

evidence.observation: robotsTxt, sitemap, robotsTxtAiRules, contentSignals pass; markdownNegotiation and linkHeaders fail; remaining fails are /.well-known agent/API/auth discovery files at the origin
evidence.limitations: Scanned the origin, not the project path; corroboration only

evidence.observation: All three pages: 200, content-type text/html; charset=utf-8, cache-control max-age=600, server GitHub.com; no X-Robots-Tag, no Link header, no auth or bot challenge
evidence.limitations: Seen from a normal browser user agent; real crawler access not verified

evidence.observation: .reports/search-optimizer/* is tracked on main but not published (Jekyll skips dot-folders); README.md states this is relied upon
evidence.limitations: Behaviour with a .nojekyll file was not tested

coverage.rationale: Same tokens (sage/hedgerow/beeswax), Alegreya + Alegreya Sans, beehive mark and calm tone on index, support and privacy at 320-1440; matches the approved look. Strategic fit beyond the approved mockup is not assessed.
No horizontal overflow and clean wrapping at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 on the sampled pages. Landscape, text-spacing overrides and real devices not tested.

Landmarks, heading order, alt text, keyboard order and a visible focus outline pass; two contrast defects: focus ring on the dark privacy panel (2.03:1) and straw list numbers on support (3.97:1). Screen reader and iOS VoiceOver not tested.
Lab only: LCP 0.7-1.6 s in 8 of 9 runs (one 3.55 s outlier from a 3.3 s TTFB), CLS <= 0.026, 97-226 KB, no JS. No field CWV exists for this new site.
Entry -> value is clear in copy, but the 'coming soon' end state offers no action, and the no-tracking promise is not matched by the website's own third-party font requests or by the privacy policy.
Host-root robots.txt allows all and lists the project sitemap; sitemap has the three canonical URLs with truthful lastmod; index meta robots index,follow; 404 noindex.
All JSON-LD parses, uses fitting types with stable @ids and agrees with visible copy; no invented offers, ratings or prices. External validator not run.
No Markdown representation or negotiation (platform cannot negotiate); optional opportunity only, largely covered by llms.txt.
Valid llms.txt proposal format, accurate facts, three valid canonical links, served 200 text/plain and linked from the host root.
Owner policy is documented (all bots welcome); all content is in the initial HTML; no X-Robots-Tag, auth or challenge. Verified-crawler access not tested (no logs on GitHub Pages).

Scoped to canonical share links: every page has a canonical/og:url equal to its sitemap URL and a 1200x630 share card. No copy/share/open-in-AI controls exist; none is recommended for a no-JS coming-soon page.

findings.title: The site promises 'No tracking' and 'collects nothing about you' but every page calls Google Fonts, and the privacy policy does not cover the website or support emails
findings.recommendation: Self-host the same fonts: download the OFL woff2 files for Alegreya 800 (+700, italic 500 if kept) and Alegreya Sans 400/500/700/800 into assets/fonts/, add @font-face rules (font-display: swap) to each page's

findings.title: Focus ring on the 'privacy policy' link in the dark privacy panel is 2.03:1, below the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11)
findings.recommendation: Add one rule after index.html:169: '.calm a:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--wax); }' (beeswax on hedgerow = 4.60:1). Only the keyboard focus state changes.

findings.title: Support 'How to play' list numbers are straw on card at 3.97:1, below 4.5:1 for 17px text (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3)
findings.recommendation: Owner proposal: in support.html:53 change 'li::marker { color: var(--straw); ... }' to 'color: #8A5D17' (a deeper straw, 5.52:1) or 'var(--soil)' (#5E4A2E, 8.09:1). Leave privacy.html bullets (non-text discs) as they are.

findings.title: 'Coming soon to the App Store' is a button-styled but inert pill and the page offers interested players no next step
findings.look: look-preserving (owner proposal for the optional pill restyle)
findings.recommendation:
Look-preserving: keep the pill and add one line after index.html:211 (and optionally after :303): '

Want a note on launch day? Email us and we will write once when it is out.

' with CSS '.launch-note { margin-top: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); }'. No App Store link, badge or price. The owner must agree to send that one email. Whether visitors actually try to tap the pill is a hypothesis to check in a 5-person hallway test; only if they do, an owner proposal is to drop the pill's lift shadow so it reads as a status badge.

findings.title: No Markdown version of the pages exists and GitHub Pages cannot negotiate Accept: text/markdown (optional opportunity)
findings.recommendation: Default: accept as a platform limit and keep llms.txt as the plain-text representation (no change). Only if the owner wants .md twins: first move the tracked .reports/ folder off the main branch, then add an empty .nojekyll file (so .md files are served raw instead of rendered), add index.md, support.md and privacy.md generated from the HTML copy, link each from its page with '<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="index.md">' and list them in llms.txt. Without moving .reports first, .nojekyll would publish the internal reports.

plan.title: Run a manual VoiceOver and real-iPhone pass over the three pages
plan.expected_impact: Closes the screen-reader and device gaps left by this lab-only audit
acceptance_checks: VoiceOver on an iPhone reads index, support and privacy in order: brand link, nav, H1, pill text, trust list, sections, footer, with no unlabeled or duplicated items
Notes saved with device, iOS version and date

plan.title: Self-host the fonts and add a 'This website' section to the privacy policy
plan.expected_impact: The no-tracking promise holds for the website too; two third-party origins removed from every page
acceptance_checks: A cold load of index, support, privacy and 404 in Chrome DevTools shows zero requests to fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com
Screenshots at 390 and 1440 match evidence/screenshots pixel-for-pixel in type (same faces and weights)
privacy.html has a 'This website' section covering hosting logs and support emails

plan.title: Use beeswax for the focus ring inside the dark privacy panel
plan.expected_impact: Keyboard users can see where focus is on the dark panel
acceptance_checks: Tabbing to 'privacy policy' at 1440 shows a #EDB841 outline; measured outline-vs-#2F5636 contrast >= 3:1

plan.title: Owner decision: darken the support list numbers
plan.expected_impact: List numbers readable at AA for low-vision users
acceptance_checks: Owner approves or declines the colour change in writing
If approved, marker colour vs #FAFBF6 measures >= 4.5:1

plan.title: Add a launch-day email line under the 'Coming soon' pill

Page still has no App Store link, badge or price
Privacy policy (T2) already states how support/launch emails are used before this ships

plan.expected_impact: Explicit record of an optional AX format; no ranking or citation effect claimed
